entities.text: Sabre Naik Ram vs The District Collector, Adilabad
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition for the respondents and perused the entire material on record.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that while admitting this writ petition, this Court on 20.02.2009 has granted interim orders and directed the respondents not to proceed with the construction of houses in the lands of the petitioner to an extent of Ac.5.00 in Sy.No.4 situated at Shanthapur Village, Gudihathnoor Mandal, Adilabad District, without following due process of law.
3. In spite of lapse of more than fifteen (15) years, the respondents did not choose to file counter or vacate petition denying the averments made by the petitioner in the writ affidavit.

::2::
4. In view of the same, the writ petition is disposed of, directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the subject lands of the petitioner without following due process of law.

If the respondents want to acquire the land of the petitioner, they have to follow the procedure as contemplated in the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: However, there shall be no order as to costs.
5. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.
